Test_Objective: Verify the panel renders every element declared in the design
Steps:
1. Open panel "Thể lệ"
2. Observe the whole panel
Expected_Result: Panel shows tiêu đề, mô tả, danh sách thưởng, 6 huy hiệu, and footer with "Đóng" + "Viết KUDOS"

Test_Objective: Verify footer button styling matches the design
Steps:
1. Open panel "Thể lệ"
2. Inspect the two footer buttons
Expected_Result: "Đóng" is secondary/outlined with icon "X" + text; "Viết KUDOS" is primary gold with pen icon + text

Test_Objective: Verify a disabled footer button is rendered dimmed
Precondition: Panel "Thể lệ" is open with a footer button in disabled state
Steps:
1. Open panel "Thể lệ"
2. Observe the disabled footer button

Test_Objective: Verify hover restyles the footer buttons
Precondition: Panel "Thể lệ" is open with footer buttons enabled
Steps:
1. Open panel "Thể lệ"
2. Hover over "Đóng"
3. Hover over "Viết KUDOS"

Test_Objective: Verify the panel scrolls when its content overflows
Test_Data: Rules content longer than the panel height
Steps:
1. Open panel "Thể lệ"
2. Scroll down inside the panel
3. Scroll back up
Expected_Result: Panel content scrolls and reaches the end of the content

Test_Objective: Verify no scrolling occurs when content fits
Test_Data: Rules content shorter than the panel height
Steps:
1. Open panel "Thể lệ"
2. Attempt to scroll inside the panel

Precondition: Panel "Thể lệ" is open over previous content
Expected_Result: Panel closes and the previous content is shown

Test_Objective: Verify "Viết KUDOS" opens the KUDOS form
Precondition: Panel "Thể lệ" is open, "Viết KUDOS" enabled

Test_Objective: Verify a disabled footer button rejects clicks
Precondition: Panel "Thể lệ" is open with a footer button in disabled state
Steps:
1. Open panel "Thể lệ"
2. Click the disabled footer button
Expected_Result: Nothing happens, no action is triggered
